verdict.rationale: Canny documents embedding a widget into a website and offers a JavaScript SDK, so the core capability of an embeddable web feedback widget is first-party. However, the evidence is mostly page titles and never shows the install snippet, so the single-script-tag, no-build-step part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that installation is a single script tag, confirmation that no build step or bundler is needed, details of the widget's install snippet and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step
